children: Cadrenal Therapeutics announced FDA alignment on Phase 3 CAD-1005 primary endpoint and trial design after a Type D meeting.
FDA agreed on an optimized definition of worsening HIT for the primary endpoint through Day 14 or hospital discharge.
Primary endpoint will measure proportion of SRA+ participants with adjudicated new or worsening composite thromboembolic events.
Worsening component includes extension of an existing thrombus into a new vascular segment/bed to reduce site variability.
FDA accepted a placebo-controlled Phase 3 design with standard anticoagulation given in both CAD-1005 and placebo arms.
